data.narrative:
Lohum Cleantech, a Series C climate and energy company founded by Rajat Verma, has raised $87.7M to date. Valuation analysis draws on two primary methods applied against a comp universe of 3 same-stage, same-sector private peers (KoBold Metals at $3.0B, Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B, and Amogy at $700M), alongside reference to a broader set of 8 private and 1 public comparable.

Stage-progression methodology applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $88M raised proxy, implying a $149M valuation. The peer-median approach anchors to the $1.0B median across the three direct comparables, reflecting the range of $700M to $3.0B observed in the peer set. These two methods produce a wide but bracketed result.

Triangulation across both approaches supports a valuation range of $127M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median implied value of $575M. The dispersion reflects material uncertainty in stage-appropriate multiples within the Climate & Energy sector, where peer valuations span nearly 5x. Key variables driving this range include capital intensity of Lohum's deployment pathway, competitive positioning within the subset of peers, and the timing assumptions embedded in stage-to-stage progression. The median estimate of $575M represents a balanced view absent additional company-specific operational or market data.
